8. **Marketing Campaign Brief**: Alex Johnson from Innovative Toys Inc. requests a marketing campaign proposal for the 'Space Explorer' toy line targeting children aged 6-12.
9. **TechCon Speaking Invitation**: Melissa Carter invites Casey to speak on a marketing panel at TechCon on May 15th regarding 'The Future of Digital Advertising in a Post-Cookie World.'
